function buildAtmosShells(__namedParameters): AtmosShellsResult

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/earth/scene/atmos-shells.ts:44

Builds both atmosphere shells sharing one scattering model: atmosMesh — BackSide additive shell (10.2u): the camera looks through the shell, so each fragment is the air between the viewer and the far wall innerMesh — FrontSide fresnel rim (+0.02u): (1 − view·n)⁶ is near-zero everywhere except the extreme grazing rim, producing the thin bright line at the limb
